title: The Search That Matches the Wrong Products
description: Searching for a complete word matches unrelated substrings, and changing input order changes tied search results.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: search(documents,query) tokenizes ASCII alphanumeric words case-insensitively. Every distinct query word must occur as a complete token in the document text. Rank matching documents by total occurrences of query words descending, then ID ascending. Empty queries return empty. Reject duplicate/empty IDs. Never mutate input. Python documents are {id,text}; C++ Document has string id,text.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
